caption: The drawing depicts a circular composition bordered by a thick, dark brown and black rim. Inside the border, the design is divided into radial segments filled with repeated patterns. The outermost layer features alternating circular motifs, including figures in blue clothing with red, white, and yellow details. These figures are set against a dark background. There are also smaller, mostly black-and-white circular shapes dispersed in pairs between the larger circles. Moving inward, there is a ring of blue circles with white geometric star-like designs and more black-and-white patterned circles. Closer to the center is a ring of large green circles filled with branching yellow-green patterns, interspersed with additional blue star-like circles and black-and-white motifs. The very center of the drawing contains some handwritten notes and is left mostly empty except for a circular arrangement of text. The drawing uses colors such as brown, black, white, blue, green, yellow, pink, and red in its design, which is symmetrically organized around the central point.
title: Valentine
